name: Services for NYCHA Residents Local Law 163
description:
This dataset lists services available to New York City Housing Authority (NYCHA) residents, reported under Local Law 163. Each of the 26 rows describes one program, including its name, service category, the city agency that provides it, a short description of what the service offers, and the geographic unit at which it is delivered (borough, council district, or NYCHA development).

Programs span several areas: employment-related services make up the largest share (about 42%), followed by financial counseling or banking services, civil service exam preparation, assistance for residents who passed the TASC high school equivalency exam, and help developing a business. Providing agencies include the Department of Small Business Services, the Department of Consumer Affairs, the Department of Social Services, NYCHA, the Department of Citywide Administrative Services, and the Department of Parks and Recreation.
